transport: Unix-domain stream socket at $FLEET_SOCKET; newline-delimited UTF-8 JSON, one object per line (newlines inside strings are JSON-escaped). This is Fleet's own protocol, not ECA's Content-Length framing.

operation.description: A tool name from tools-v1.json, or `tools_list`, or `ping`.

credential.description: Runtime token from $FLEET_CREDENTIAL_FILE. Absent for tools_list/ping only.

idempotencyKey.description: Required for mutations; bound to the logical actor, not the runtime.

errorCodes.invalid-request: Malformed JSON, oversize line, wrong protocolVersion, or schema violation.
errorCodes.stale-runtime: Credential belongs to a revoked or non-current runtime incarnation.
errorCodes.forbidden: Operation not permitted for this actor/role or outside its fleet/task.
errorCodes.revision-mismatch: expected_revision does not match the entity.
errorCodes.action-payload-mismatch: Same idempotency key reused with different arguments.
errorCodes.owner-unproven: This Emacs no longer holds the Fleet lease.
errorCodes.read-only: Store opened read-only (another Emacs owns the root).
errorCodes.fleet-not-active: Fleet parked/parking/retiring; operators cannot be started or messaged.
errorCodes.*: Any fleet-error code from the owning module (e.g. deliverable-unverified, runtime-not-stopped, brief-not-runnable, invalid-task, dependency-unsatisfied, resource-claimed, terminal-phase, no-such-decision).
